title: Text is readable against its background
note: Body text, labels and controls meet readable contrast in both light and dark colour schemes.
intent: Light grey on white is the most common way a page becomes unreadable. Body text should reach a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background, large text and the borders of controls at least 3:1. Do not use colour alone to carry meaning (an error also gets an icon or text). Define the palette as variables once, with a dark variant for prefers-color-scheme: dark, and check muted text in particular, since that is where contrast quietly fails. A placeholder is not a label.

check.ask: Is all text, including muted captions and labels, easy to read against its background?
check.note: Text is readable against its background everywhere, muted text included.

port: Colour tokens live in styles.css with a documented contrast pair for each text/background combination; components use the tokens.
